We have confused unbalanced trade with free trade. FREE trade balances through currency. I GET the libertarian argument. I was trained at the cathedral of it (Wharton). Everything moves in cycles. Intrusive and abusive government is a symptom of a fraying society. It’s not that other countries have “stolen” from us.
